answer.reason: Two verses state events of this Kir: the captivity of Damascus's people there, and the LORD bringing the Syrians from it.

clauses.english: received the people of Damascus, carried captive by the king of Assyria
clauses.quote: carried the people of it captive to Kir

clauses.english: was the place the LORD brought the Syrians up from

doubts: ISA 15:1 names Kir of Moab, probably a different place, so it was left out.
ISA 22:6 (Kir uncovered the shield) comes in a vision of future trouble and is unclear, so it was left out.
AMO 1:5 only foretells the captivity to Kir, which 2KI 16:9 already states as done.
